source.note: Artwork is extracted here. Names, classes and meanings are carried over; nothing is inferred.

signs.name: Stop
signs.meaning: Stop your vehicle with its front end in line with the sign and do not proceed until it is safe to do so.

signs.name: Stop/Yield
signs.meaning: If you wish to proceed straight-on or to the right at the junction ahead, you shall act as for STOP sign; if you want to proceed to the left at the junction ahead, you shall yield right of way to all traffic, from the right (both vehicular and pedestrian), on the road which is joined by the road on which you are travelling where such traffic is so close as to constitute a danger or potential danger.

signs.name: 4 - Way Stop
signs.meaning: If you are approaching a 4 Way Stop sign, you shall stop such vehicle, and not proceed into the junction until every vehicle which has stopped at any other STOP LINE marking at such junction first , and which would, in the normal course of events, cross the path of your vehicle, has cleared the junction. In short, stop and than 1st come, 1st go!

signs.name: Stop or Go
signs.meaning: This sign is used by temporary scholar patrols or for other temporary use, such as a police road block. Stop-and-Go sign indicates to you that you shall act as for Stop sign when “STOP” is displayed and; if “GO” is displayed, you shall proceed with caution.

signs.name: Yield
signs.meaning: Yield right-of-way to all traffic on the road which is joined by the road on which you are travelling; or rail traffic on the railway line which is crossed by the road on which you are travelling, where such traffic is so close as to constitute a danger or potential danger.

signs.name: Yield to Pedestrian
signs.meaning: If you are approaching such a sign you shall yield right-of-way to pedestrians crossing the public road, or waiting to cross the public road.

signs.name: Yield at Mini Circle
signs.meaning: If you are approaching a mini circle you shall yield right of way to any vehicle which will cross any YIELD LINE at such junction before you, and which, in the normal course of events, will cross the path of your vehicle. You shall move in a clockwise direction in such junction and attempt not to encroach on the mini circle.

signs.name: No Entry
signs.meaning: The entry of all vehicular traffic is prohibited.

signs.name: One-Way Road (left)
signs.meaning: Proceed left (direction indicated by the arrow).

signs.name: One-Way Road (right)
signs.meaning: Proceed right (direction indicated by the arrow).

signs.name: One-Way Road (straight)
signs.meaning: Proceed straight (direction indicated by the arrow).

signs.name: Pedestrian Priority
signs.meaning: The pedestrian priority sign is to indicate to drivers of vehicles that only pedestrians shall be permitted in an area set aside as a pedestrian precinct marked by such signs and the contemplated vehicles such as loading goods, maintenance or emergency vehicles. In cases where drivers of these exempted vehicles pass beyond the point where such sign is displayed they shall yield right-of-way to all pedestrians who are crossing or who are about to cross their way; observe a maximum speed of 15 kilometres per hour unless another speed limit is indicated by another sign and, if delivering or loading goods, shall do so in places specifically marked for such purpose in such area.

signs.name: Yield to oncoming Traffic
signs.meaning: If you are approaching such a sign, you shall yield right-of-way to all oncoming traffic and shall proceed only when it is safe to do so.

signs.name: Minimum Speed
signs.meaning: Maintain or exceed the minimum speed indicated in kilometres per hour by means of a number on the sign.

signs.name: Vehicles Exceeding Mass Only
signs.meaning: The use of a public road or portion of public road by drivers of vehicles is restricted to vehicles of a mass that exceeds that indicated in tonnes by means of a number only and that the driver of such a vehicle shall only use the public road or portion of public road designated by the sign. The value indicated in tonnes is the equivalent of the gross vehicle mass (GVM) or gross combination mass (GCM) of the vehicle in kilograms.

signs.name: Keep Left Only
signs.meaning: Pass only to the left-hand side, as indicated by the arrow, of an obstacle in the road on which the sign has been placed.

signs.name: Proceed Left Only
signs.meaning: Proceed only in the direction indicated by the arrow on such sign.

signs.name: Turn Left Only Ahead
signs.meaning: Proceed only in direction indicated by the arrow on such sign, at the junction ahead.

signs.meaning: Road is set aside for pedal cycles and pedestrians only

signs.meaning: Road is set aside for motor cyclists only

signs.name: Pay Toll
signs.meaning: Road is designated as a toll road and if you are able to pay the toll charge at the toll plaza or plazas, continue using the road, else use an alternative road.

signs.name: Switch Head Lamps On
signs.meaning: Switch on such vehicle’s head lamps to emit a dipped-beam.

signs.name: Buses and Minibuses Only
signs.meaning: Road is set aside for all classes of buses and minibuses only

signs.name: Traffic circle
signs.meaning: If you are entering a traffic circle you shall turn to the left and shall travel round the traffic circle in a clockwise direction and you shall yield right-of-way to traffic approaching from the right, within the traffic circle, where such traffic is so close as to constitute a danger or potential danger.

signs.name: Trams Only
signs.meaning: Road is set aside for trams only

signs.name: Speed Limit
signs.meaning: You shall not exceed the speed limit indicated in kilometers per hour, by means of a number on such sign, beyond such sign.

signs.name: Mass Limit
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles with a mass in excess of the mass indicated in tones, by means of a number on the sign, shall not proceed beyond such sign on a public road. The value indicated in tones is the gross vehicle mass (GVM) or gross combination mass (GCM) of the vehicle

signs.name: Axle Massload Limit
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles with an axle massload in excess of the mass indicated in tonnes by means of a number on such sign, shall not proceed beyond such sign on a public road.

signs.name: Height Limit
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles on a public road shall not proceed beyond the sign or drive under a height gauge or structure to which the sign is attached unless the height of the vehicle, including any load thereon, and, in the case of a height gauge, any radio antenna attached to the vehicle, is less than the clearance height indicated in meters by means of a number on such sign.

signs.name: Length Limit
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles which are in excess of the length indicated in meters by means of number on such sign shall not proceed beyond such sign on a public road. The value indicated in meters on such sign is the maximum length of the vehicle or combination of vehicles, including any projections.

signs.name: No Excessive Noise
signs.meaning: Drivers shall not sound their vehicle sounding device or hooter for 100m after passing sign, AND drivers shall not drive a vehicle beyond such sign, if such vehicle is emitting noise in excess of noise levels prescribed.

signs.name: No Hitch-Hiking
signs.meaning: Pedestrians shall not attempt to secure a lift from a passing vehicle AND drivers of vehicles shall not pick-up passengers. The prohibition on hitch-hiking is effective for a distance of 500m beyond such sign.

signs.name: No Unauthorised vehicles
signs.meaning: Drivers of unauthorised vehicles shall not proceed beyond such sign.

signs.name: No Left Turn Ahead
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall not turn to the left at the junction or entrance ahead.

signs.name: No Left Turn
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall NOT turn to the left.

signs.name: No U-Turn
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall NOT turn their vehicles so as to face in the opposite direction.

signs.name: No Overtaking - All Vehicles
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall not overtake another vehicle traveling in the same direction. The prohibition on overtaking is effective for distance of 500m beyond such sign.

signs.name: No Overtaking Goods Vehicles
signs.meaning: Drivers of goods vehicles shall not overtake another goods vehicle traveling in the same direction. The prohibition on overtaking is effective for distance of 500m beyond such sign.

signs.name: No Parking
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall NOT park their vehicles at any time on any portion of a public road.

signs.name: No Stopping
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall NOT stop their vehicles at any time on any portion of public road. Such a requirement does not apply if a driver is acting in compliance with a traffic signal or the signal of a traffic officer or to avoid a collision.

signs.name: Width Limit
signs.meaning: Drivers of vehicles shall NOT proceed beyond the sign if the width of their vehicle is equal to or greater than that indicated in meters by means of a number on such sign.

signs.name: Towed Vehicles Prohibited

signs.name: No Hawkers
signs.meaning: No hawkers are allowed within 75 metres on either side of such sign.

signs.name: Woonerf
signs.meaning: A driver may not enter the area driving a vehicle with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 3500kg or a vehicle with more than 10 seats for passengers except for local access or delivery; must yield right of way to pedestrians and children; and may not drive faster than 30km/h or as indicated by a sign

signs.meaning: Dual carriageway freeway begins

signs.name: Two periods time limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies only during the two periods of time indicated on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Three periods or days time limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies only during the two periods of time on weekdays and on Saturdays as indicated on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Maximum stay during two periods or days time limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies only during the period of time on a weekday and a different period of time on a Saturday as indicated on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Daytime condition
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies during the day

signs.name: Night-time condition
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies during the night

signs.name: Mass limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies to vehicles with a gross vehicle mass (GVM) exceeding the mass indicated in tonnes by the number on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Motorcycle engine size limit
signs.meaning: When displaed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies to motorcycles with a rated engine capacity up to the capacity indicated in cm3 by the number on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Local access limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the reservation also permits access by road users to local public or local private property located on a section of road beyond that sign

signs.name: Maximum number of vehicles
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign, the reservation indicated on the sign is further restricted to a maximum number on the exclusive secondary sign

signs.name: Motor car
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the regulatory sign applies only to motor cars or any other motor vehicle indicated on the sign

signs.name: Distance limit
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign, the regulatory sign applies for the distance indicated in m or km by the number on the exclusive secondary sign, but the maximum distance which may be displayed is 5km

signs.name: Reserved movement left by vehicle class
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the restriction indicated on the exclusive secondary sign applies to the direction indicated by the arrow

signs.name: Reserved movement right by vehicle class
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the restriction indicated on the exclusive secondary sign applies to the direction indicated by the arrow

signs.name: Reserved movement left and right by vehicle class
signs.meaning: When displayed below a regulatory sign the restriction indicated on the exclusive secondary sign applies to the direction indicated by the arrow

signs.name: Pay and display
signs.meaning: When displayed below a parking reservation sign, the use of the parking area is subject to payment at a pay station

signs.name: Cross Road
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a crossroad ahead.

signs.name: Priority Crossroad
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a crossroad ahead and that you are travelling on an approach that has priority over intersecting approaches.

signs.name: Secondary Crossroad
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a crossroad ahead and that you are travelling on an approach that DOES NOT has priority over intersecting approaches.

signs.name: T - Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a T-Junction ahead where traffic is required to make a sharp or acute turn either to the left or to the right.

signs.name: Skew T - Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a skew T-junction ahead where traffic is required to make a sharp or acute turn either to the left or to the right.

signs.name: Side-road Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a side road junction ahead where traffic might enter the road from the left.

signs.name: Staggered junctions
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a staggered junction ahead where traffic might enter the road from the right or left.

signs.name: Sharp Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a sharp junction from the left is ahead

signs.name: Sharp Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a sharp junction from the right is ahead

signs.name: Y-Junction
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a Y-junction ahead and that the road forms the stem of the Y.

signs.name: End of Dual Road
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a two-way road that is ending and that a one-way road is about to be entered at which point a physical median island will commence.

signs.name: Beginning of Dual Road

signs.name: Mini circle or traffic circle
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a mini circle or traffic circle ahead

signs.name: Gentle curve
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a gentle curve ahead

signs.name: Sharp curve
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a sharp curve ahead

signs.name: Hairpin bend
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a sharp u-shaped bend ahead

signs.name: Winding road
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a series of curves in the road ahead starting with a curve to the left or right

signs.name: Combined curves
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a combination of two sharp curves in opposite directions ahead

signs.name: Two-way traffic
signs.meaning: The sign warns you on a one-way road that the road ahead carries traffic in both directions

signs.name: Two-way traffic crossroad

signs.name: Lane ends

signs.name: Concealed driveway
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about other vehicles that may enter road ahead from driveways on the right or left or both sides in such a manner that due to restricted sight they may constitute a hazard

signs.name: Traffic Signal Ahead

signs.name: Traffic Control “Yield” Ahead

signs.name: Pedal cycles

signs.name: Farm Animals

signs.name: Wild Animals ahead

signs.name: Gate

signs.name: Motor Gate

signs.name: Railway Crossing

signs.name: Tunnel
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the presence of a tunnel on the road ahead. The use of headlights may be required.

signs.name: Height Restricted
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the clearance of height gauge located ahead of a railway crossing over which overhead electrical power cables are installed; or an overhead structure is restricted in metres by the number indicated on the sign.

signs.name: Length Restricted
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the permissible length of vehicles is restricted because the lateral clearances to bridge parapets, retaining walls, road traffic signs or other road furniture is limited due to road curvature or some other design feature of construction

signs.name: Steep Ascent
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a steep uphill section road ahead which may require changing to a lower gear.

signs.name: Steep descent
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a steep downhill section of road ahead which may, particularly for heavy vehicles constitute a hazard and may require changing to a lower gear.

signs.name: Slow moving heavy vehicles
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that due to the steep downhill section of road ahead, heavy vehicles may be travelling very slowly in a low gear, which combined with reduced visibility conditions due to road curvature or weather, constitutes a potential hazard.

signs.name: Gravel Road Begins
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road surface on which you are travelling is about to change from asphalt or tar or concrete to gravel.

signs.name: Narrow Bridge
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the width of road is reduced over short distance at a bridge on the road ahead.

signs.name: One vehicle width structure
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the width of the structure on the road ahead is less than 5m and that you shall stop at the entrance thereto if a vehicle approaching from the opposite direction is already on the structure, or so close thereto as to constitute a danger.

signs.name: Road Narrows from both sides
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road ahead narrows from both sides.

signs.name: Road narrows from one side only - Right
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road ahead narrows from the right side only.

signs.name: Uneven road
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that there is a dip or ridge in the road or that the road surface is generally uneven or potholed.

signs.name: Speed Humps
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of speed humps on the road ahead which require a reduction in speed.

signs.name: Slippery Road
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of abnormally slippery conditions on the road ahead for which a considerable reduction in speed is necessary.

signs.name: Falling Rocks
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of the possibility of falling rocks or stones on the right of the road ahead.

signs.name: Roadworks
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about temporary road construction, maintenance or related work in progress ahead

signs.name: Grader working
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a grader working on the road ahead

signs.name: Loose stones
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about loose stones or gravel on the road ahead

signs.name: General Warning
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that there is a hazard of a general or random nature in the road ahead.

signs.name: Surface step
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a hazardous change in the surface of the road

signs.name: Soft shoulder
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the material of the shoulder of the road that is softer than would be reasonably expected and constitute a hazard to anyone wishing to pull off road

signs.name: “Stop/Go” control ahead
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the traffic ahead is temporarily controlled by a portable “Stop/Go” sign

signs.name: Construction vehicles crossing
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about construction vehicles that regularly cross or enter the road ahead from the left or right

signs.name: Emergency Flashing Light
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of a hazard ahead, by means of an intermittent flashing yellow circular light within the warning sign.

signs.name: Temporary police flashing light
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of presence of police at a temporary stop sign ahead or of an accident site or similar occurrence where the police are present

signs.name: Jetty Edge or River-bank
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road ahead leads to a hazardous jetty edge or a river bank

signs.name: Crosswinds
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the possibility of severe crosswinds ahead which are capable of deflecting a vehicle from its path.

signs.name: Drift
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of a drift ahead which may contain water, flash floods after thunder storms, rock outcrops or loose material or which may represent a hazardous depression in the road when dry.

signs.name: Low Flying Aircraft
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of the likelihood of the presence of low flying aircraft in the vicinity of the road, the sudden noise of which may constitute a hazard.

signs.name: Agricultural vehicles
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that tractors or other slow moving agricultural vehicle regularly cross or enter the road ahead.

signs.name: Accident ahead
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of presence of an accident ahead

signs.name: Reduced visibility
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of the possibility of reduced visibility ahead due to mist, fog or smoke which constitutes a hazard and may require a considerable reduction in speed.

signs.name: Congestion
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of the possibility of slow-moving or stationary traffic in the road ahead which may constitute hazard due to limited visibility due to road alignment or traffic density and which may require the driver to significantly reduce speed or to stop.

signs.name: Horses and Riders
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of the possible presence of horses in the road ahead which are being ridden or led by their riders and which may constitute a hazard if disturbed by passing traffic.

signs.name: Elephants
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the possible presence of elephants on the public road ahead.

signs.name: Warthogs
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the possible presence of warthogs on the public road ahead.

signs.name: Hippopotamus
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about the possible presence of hippopotamus (hippos) on the public road ahead.

signs.name: Width Restricted
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the width of the road ahead is restricted and that a prohibition on vehicles with a width equal to or greater than that indicated in metres by means of a number on such sign.

signs.name: Electrical Shock
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that there are potentially live overhead electrical power cables ahead and that these may constitute a hazard if contacted by a vehicle or any vertical projection carried by the road user.

signs.name: Gravel Road Ends
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the gravel road on which you are travelling is about to end and that the road surface will become asphalt, tar or concrete which may contain a hazardous step in the surface.

signs.name: Danger plate
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of an obstruction or alteration in the road alignment to the left or right.

signs.name: Delineator plate
signs.meaning: The sign warns you of temporary obstruction or alteration in the road alignment to the left or right.

signs.name: Railway crossing
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a hazardous change in the surface of the road

signs.name: Sharp curve chevron
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road ahead is diverted to the right or left owing to a sudden change of direction.

signs.name: Overhead danger plate

signs.name: T-junction chevron
signs.meaning: The sign warns that the road does not continue beyond the junction and a turn must be made to the left or right.

signs.name: Dead end or road closed chevron
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that the road does not continue beyond the sign.

signs.name: Boom barricade
signs.meaning: The sign warns you that a portion of the road is temporarily closed to traffic.

signs.name: Gore plate

signs.name: Gore chevron
signs.meaning: The sign warns you about a physical separation in the road ahead which the driver must pass to the left or right.
